payload.description: chapter names one chapter of one book by its spine index.

reply.description: The chapter's title and its strict-XHTML fragment, or an honest error: not-found when the book or index is gone, unavailable when the server could not be reached (5).

tool.description: Returns one chapter's whole text, by the book's id and the chapter's number. Use to read what a chapter actually says. The book id comes from listing the books or from checking what is open; the chapter number comes from the book's chapters, from where the reader is in it, or from a highlight. A chapter is long, so read only the chapters that matter; for the passage the reader is at now, ask where they are in the book instead.
tool.label: Reading a chapter
tool.title: Chapter text
tool.name: /title
